name: vscode-nexus
description: Investigate a defect without leaving the editor. Nexus decides what evidence is needed and what it means; your IDE agent fetches it with your own connected tools. Read-only toward your repository.

commands.title: Nexus: Sign out of the Nexus server

chatParticipants.name: nexus
chatParticipants.description: Investigate a defect with your connected tools. Nexus decides; your agent only fetches evidence.

commands.name: investigate
commands.description: Investigate a defect, for example /investigate PAY-1423

nexus.server.mode.description: stdio: start a local Nexus server. http: connect to a Nexus server inside your company's network.

nexus.server.command.description: stdio mode: command that starts the Nexus MCP server.

nexus.server.args.description: stdio mode: arguments. Use the same command as your IDE's mcp.json entry, so both share one Nexus data folder.

nexus.server.env.description: stdio mode: extra environment, for example NEXUS_IDE_DB. Never put Jira, GitHub or database credentials here: Nexus does not use them.

nexus.server.url.description: http mode: the Nexus MCP endpoint.

nexus.server.callbackPort.description: http mode: loopback port for the Nexus sign-in redirect.

nexus.repositories.description: Repositories in owner/name form. Empty: taken from the workspace's GitHub remote.

nexus.hideEvidenceExcerpts.description: Hide evidence excerpts in the report and hovers, for screenshots and screen sharing.
